title: 三电压表法口试问答

author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/17_Three Voltmeter Method Viva Voce Questions and answers Basic Electrical Engineer/src.py

points.K2: 感抗：电感对交流的阻碍
points.K4: 阻抗：交流电路的总阻碍
points.K6: 扼流线圈的阻抗怎么算
points.K10: 容抗：电容对交流的阻碍
points.K12: 扼流线圈与双向晶闸管

shots.scene: 欣欣站在电工实验台前，台上放着一个铁芯线圈和三块电压表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at an electrical lab bench with an iron-core coil and three analog voltmeters with blank dials, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 大家好！今天聊三电压表法的口试题。

shots.scene: 线圈、三块电压表、问号卡片三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: an iron-core coil, three small voltmeters, and a card with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 概念、公式、单位，一题一题过。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验台旁抱着空白笔记本发愁，小研拿着空白卡片考他
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks worried holding a blank notebook beside a lab bench, while the female graduate student holds up blank flash cards to quiz him.
shots.narration: 明天口试，阿杰心里没底。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard holding up one finger.
shots.narration: 别急，常考的题我们挨个过。

shots.scene: 一个铁芯线圈图标，旁边是带问号的电阻和电感符号
shots.prompt_en: An iron-core choke coil icon next to a resistor symbol and an inductor symbol, each with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：三电压表法是干什么的？

shots.scene: 线圈与一个已知电阻串联，三块电压表分别并在电阻、线圈和总电路两端
shots.prompt_en: A circuit icon: a known resistor in series with a coil on an AC source, with three voltmeters across the resistor, across the coil, and across both. No people.
shots.narration: 已知电阻和线圈串联，三块表各测一段。

shots.scene: 小研看着三块电表读数，在空白纸上计算
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads three blank-dial voltmeters and calculates on a blank sheet of paper.
shots.narration: 答：测出未知线圈的电阻和电感。

shots.section_title: 感抗：电感对交流的阻碍
shots.scene: 交流电源接一个电感的小电路，电流箭头经过线圈变细
shots.prompt_en: A small circuit icon: an AC source connected to an inductor coil, the current arrow narrowing as it passes through the coil. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：什么是感抗？
overlay: 感抗：电感对交流的阻碍

shots.section_title: 感抗：电感对交流的阻碍
shots.scene: 欣欣指着线圈图标，线圈像闸门挡住水流
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a coil icon that holds back a flowing arrow like a gate holding back water.
shots.narration: 电感对交流电流的阻碍，就叫感抗。

shots.section_title: 感抗：电感对交流的阻碍
shots.scene: 白板上写着感抗公式
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with a simple formula written in symbols only, an inductor icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 感抗等于角频率乘电感。

shots.section_title: 感抗：电感对交流的阻碍
shots.scene: 欧姆符号图标放大
shots.prompt_en: A large ohm symbol icon in the center. No people.
shots.narration: 感抗的单位是欧姆。

shots.scene: 线圈图标旁一个大写字母 H 的图标
shots.prompt_en: A coil icon next to a large capital letter H icon. No people.
shots.narration: 顺便问：电感的单位？答：亨利。

shots.section_title: 阻抗：交流电路的总阻碍
shots.scene: 电阻、电感、电容三个图标连成一串，接在交流电源上
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a resistor, an inductor and a capacitor connected in series to an AC source. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：什么是阻抗？
overlay: 阻抗：交流电路的总阻碍

shots.section_title: 阻抗：交流电路的总阻碍
shots.scene: 三个元件的阻碍箭头合成一个大箭头
shots.prompt_en: Three small blocking arrows from a resistor, an inductor and a capacitor merging into one big arrow with a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻、电感、电容对交流的总阻碍。

shots.section_title: 阻抗：交流电路的总阻碍
shots.scene: 交流波形打勾，直流直线标问号
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a sine wave with a green check and a straight DC line with a grey question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 阻抗用在交流电路，符号 Z，单位欧姆。

shots.section_title: 阻抗：交流电路的总阻碍
shots.scene: 白板上写着 RLC 串联阻抗公式
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with a series RLC impedance formula in symbols only. No people.
shots.narration: 串联时，感抗容抗先相减再合成。

shots.scene: 两块电表图标：一块标交流波形，一块标直流直线
shots.prompt_en: Two meter icons with blank dials: one marked with a sine wave, one marked with a straight line. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：动铁式和动圈式仪表有何不同？

shots.scene: 动铁式电表接在交流电路上，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A moving iron meter icon connected to an AC circuit with a sine wave, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 测交流，选动铁式仪表。

shots.scene: 动圈式电表接在交流电路上的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A moving coil meter icon connected to an AC source with a sine wave, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 测直流选动圈式，别拿它测交流。

shots.scene: 老周拿起一块电表，查看表盘上的小符号
shots.prompt_en: The older man picks up an analog meter and examines the small symbols printed on its dial face.
shots.narration: 交流直流，仪表一定要选对。

shots.section_title: 扼流线圈的阻抗怎么算
shots.scene: 三电压表电路图标，第三块电压表和电流箭头高亮
shots.prompt_en: The three-voltmeter circuit icon with the third voltmeter and the current arrow highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：线圈阻抗怎么算？
overlay: 扼流线圈的阻抗怎么算

shots.section_title: 扼流线圈的阻抗怎么算
shots.scene: 小研在空白纸上把一个读数除以另一个读数
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student divides one reading by another on a blank sheet of paper.
shots.narration: 用第三块表的电压除以电流。

shots.section_title: 扼流线圈的阻抗怎么算
shots.scene: 电阻和电感组成的直角三角形图标
shots.prompt_en: A right-triangle icon whose two short sides are a resistor and an inductor and whose long side is marked Z. No people.
shots.narration: 一般 RL 电路，按直角三角形合成。

shots.scene: 频率旋钮调高，感抗柱子跟着升高
shots.prompt_en: A frequency dial icon turning up, and a bar marked with an inductor icon rising with it. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：感抗和频率什么关系？

shots.scene: 一条从原点向上的直线图
shots.prompt_en: A simple graph with a straight line rising from the origin. No people.
shots.narration: 感抗与频率成正比，频率越高感抗越大。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白笔记本上抄写公式图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student copies formula icons into a blank notebook at his desk.
shots.narration: 公式和概念，记在本子上常复习。

shots.scene: 阿杰面对王老师简短回答，王老师点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student answers briefly in front of the safety administrator, who nods.
shots.narration: 口试回答抓要点，简明清楚。

shots.scene: 阿杰自信地边说边比划，王老师认真听
shots.prompt_en: The young male student explains confidently with hand gestures; the safety administrator listens attentively.
shots.narration: 答得有条理，努力说服考官。

shots.scene: 正弦波图标旁一个时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A sine wave icon next to a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 补充题：频率的单位是赫兹。

shots.scene: 一个旋转的圆和弧线箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a rotating circle with a curved arrow showing angle. No people.
shots.narration: 角频率的单位是弧度每秒。

shots.section_title: 容抗：电容对交流的阻碍
shots.scene: 交流电源接电容的小电路图标
shots.prompt_en: A small circuit icon: an AC source connected to a capacitor. No people.
shots.narration: 什么是容抗？
overlay: 容抗：电容对交流的阻碍

shots.section_title: 容抗：电容对交流的阻碍
shots.scene: 电容图标挡住部分电流箭头
shots.prompt_en: A capacitor icon partly holding back a flowing current arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 电容对交流电流的阻碍，叫容抗。

shots.section_title: 容抗：电容对交流的阻碍
shots.scene: 白板上写着容抗公式
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with a capacitive reactance formula in symbols only. No people.
shots.narration: 容抗等于一除以角频率乘电容。

shots.section_title: 容抗：电容对交流的阻碍
shots.scene: 欧姆符号图标
shots.prompt_en: A large ohm symbol icon. No people.
shots.narration: 容抗单位也是欧姆。

shots.scene: 频率旋钮调高，容抗柱子反而变矮
shots.prompt_en: A frequency dial icon turning up while a bar marked with a capacitor icon gets shorter. No people.
shots.narration: 容抗和频率成反比。

shots.scene: 一条先陡后平的下降曲线图
shots.prompt_en: A simple graph with a curve falling steeply then flattening, like a hyperbola. No people.
shots.narration: 画出来是一条下降的双曲线形曲线。

shots.scene: 上升直线和下降曲线并排对比
shots.prompt_en: Two small graphs side by side: a rising straight line and a falling curve. No people.
shots.narration: 一个随频率升，一个随频率降。

shots.section_title: 扼流线圈与双向晶闸管
shots.scene: 一个铁芯扼流线圈图标
shots.prompt_en: An iron-core choke coil icon. No people.
shots.narration: 扼流线圈就是一种电感器。
overlay: 扼流线圈与双向晶闸管

shots.section_title: 扼流线圈与双向晶闸管
shots.scene: 笨重的旧式线圈调压器和小巧的电子调压器并排
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: a bulky old coil-type regulator and a small electronic regulator box. No people.
shots.narration: 过去用线圈调压，现多被电子装置替代。

shots.section_title: 扼流线圈与双向晶闸管
shots.scene: 一个三端器件符号图标，三根引脚
shots.prompt_en: A three-terminal power semiconductor symbol icon with three leads. No people.
shots.narration: 这种电子器件叫双向晶闸管。

shots.section_title: 扼流线圈与双向晶闸管
shots.scene: 双向箭头穿过器件图标
shots.prompt_en: A two-way arrow passing through a semiconductor device icon. No people.
shots.narration: 三个端子，双向导通，用来调交流电压。

shots.section_title: 扼流线圈与双向晶闸管
shots.scene: 空白教材封面上画着电力电子图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank textbook with a power electronics icon on its cover. No people.
shots.narration: 电气电子专业，高年级会深入学。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手，王老师走过来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand and the safety administrator walks over.
shots.narration: 复习有疑问，及时问老师。

shots.scene: 感抗、阻抗、容抗三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: an inductor, a series RLC chain, and a capacitor, each with an ohm symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 感抗、容抗、阻抗，单位都是欧姆。

shots.scene: 上升直线和下降曲线两个小图
shots.prompt_en: A rising straight line graph and a falling curve graph side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 感抗随频率升，容抗随频率降。

shots.scene: 动铁式电表配交流、三电压表电路两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a moving iron meter with a sine wave, and the three-voltmeter circuit. No people.
shots.narration: 交流选动铁式，线圈阻抗用电压除电流。

shots.scene: 空白笔记本和举起的手两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a blank notebook and a raised hand. No people.
shots.narration: 公式常复习，回答简明有自信。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整理好的实验台前挥手，阿杰在旁竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at a tidy, switched-off lab bench while the young male student gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 祝口试顺利，下次见！
